_readme: Pre-written replies for free mode: test shows that call no LLM and cost no tokens.
The relay uses this file when a request has "free": true (see Relay/README.md); the relay bundles it at build time, so a change here needs a push to reach it.

phases: how to tell which ask a request is, checked in order. A phase matches when the state has the 'when_field' key, or its 'ask' text contains one of 'ask_contains'. The first match wins; 'scene_turn' is the fallback.

Each phase says what to fill: 'lines' (speech), 'reasons' (reason), 'vote' (a random name from options), 'actions' (how many, from 'scene_actions'), 'pass_chance' (Free Talk only), 'echo_typed' (the input step: speech = the player's typed text, cut to 25 words).

Placeholders: {actor} = a random cast name other than you, {vote} = the chosen vote, {place} = a random place, {prop} = a random prop. Names come from the state the game sends (cast, set.places, set.props, options, you).
scene_actions: the actions a free actor may take, with weights. target and item use the same placeholders.
Lines follow the game's legibility rules: plain sentences, 15 words at most, no brackets, emoji or all-caps words, no real names and no company names.

reasons: Cut {vote}. That last scene had no heart, only lag.
{vote} goes. Too careful, too human. Print it.
I pick {vote}. Nobody that nervous runs on a battery.
{vote}. The timing was off all night. That's a wrap.
{vote} felt too human to me from the very first scene.
I suspected {vote} all show. The pauses gave it away.
{vote} never once complained about a low battery. Suspicious.
My money was on {vote}. Those jokes were too warm.
{vote} paused before every line, like someone thinking for real.
{vote} picked up the {prop} like it had feelings about it.
{vote} never mentioned an upgrade once. No robot does that.
{vote} laughed at the wrong moment. Very human of them.
{vote} wandered to the {place} for no reason at all.

lines: Fine. I was an AI all along. Enjoy your mistake.

I knew it. Wait, no, I did not know it.
One less robot on stage. I feel a little lonely.

{actor}, why did you hesitate before your last line?
